hook.text: Your agents write all day. Plans. Reviews. Reports. And you read them... as raw text, in a terminal.

reveal.text: Meet snigh-vee. A fast, beautiful viewer for everything your agents produce.

ask.text: Ask Claude Code for a plan. It writes one. And sends it. One real MCP call: send document.

arrive.text: By the time you read the reply, it's already open. Rendered. Filed under the project.

queue.text: A new document never steals the page. It waits at the top. N opens it.

diff.text: C shows exactly what changed since the last version.

diagram.text: Diagrams draw themselves, in the page's own colours.

search.text: Command K searches everything every agent has ever sent. Code included.

source.text: Source files, highlighted, with an outline. Ten thousand lines of Rust, in a hundred and forty-three milliseconds.

numbers.text: One static binary. Twelve megabytes. Cold start in eleven milliseconds. And nothing phones home.

agents.text: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Zed. Any agent that speaks MCP. One command each.

outro.text: Agents send. snigh-vee shows. Get it on GitHub.
